top_signals.title: ‘Last chance’: Bessent says Hormuz deal is in sight after Trump's warning on Iran talks
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump has warned that the latest round of negotiations with Iran are the "last chance" to bring an end to the five-month conflict.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Sundial’s Richelieu Dennis on Revolt Stake, Essence Fest
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Romaine Bosick sits down with Richelieu Dennis, Founder and Chair of The Sundial Group of Companies, as his brand Essence Ventures makes a strategic investment in Revolt's parent company, Offscript Worldwide. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
